items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: Until Mr. Bill Russell picked him up and took him there and made something, you know, brought him back in light again.

ctx.x: I liked him a lot. Nice easy going.

Always was a nice easy going fella. And Bunk could play sweet. All of them tried to imitate Buddy Bowling. That's where Bunk got that style following Buddy Bowling with this sweetness. Bunk had a sweet and lovely tone. He never was rough. He never could play loud and rough like Buddy Bowling. But when Bunk left and went back home and he joined that band out there in New Iberia, well people had to have forgot about him. Until Mr. Bill Russell picked him up and took him there and made something, you know, brought…

Yeah. I saw him. I wondered about you a little more about your brothers. About Remus now. He was the oldest. Do you know, did he have any lessons or when did he start? Did he ever tell you, of course he was older than you, but did he ever tell you when he started on drums, how big he was? My brother?
